factor: Require the sign-adjusted trailing 90-day spot-price return rank to lie in the leading fraction among all contemporaneously observable OKX perpetual contracts in the frozen, partially survivorship-biased 291-contract universe. Longs use descending return; shorts ascending. Unavailable assets excluded at that time.
timing: A 180-step 12h return uses both closes ending before or at the OPEN of the signal key, and requires 181 consecutive observed 12h bars. At least 10 contemporaneous contracts with a calculable rank. Equal-weight midpoint fractional rank (rank - 0.5)/n. No future membership features. Controls use their own current rank and require parent eligibility as well.
comparators: Unfiltered frozen priority parent with all history, and coverage-matched 100% ranked arm. Frozen parent has exactly nine slots and a 75% partial at original 2R.
selection: Development through 2024 maximum terminal account value with at least 100 closed trades, >=30% net winners, >=2.5 realized net payoff and <=35% hourly DD upper bound. If no eligible arm then frozen parent. Disclose previously analyzed 2025 and 2026, pair and 5bp stress for selected and development maximum when new.
